inventory.name: Sealing Javelins
inventory.effect: If this item hits a model with Incorporeal or Undead Trait, it automatically suffers 2 Wounds (no DMG roll necessary).

stratagems.name: Hunter Tactics
stratagems.effect: Target model may perform Walk during its End Phase.

stratagems.name: Stalwart Defenders
stratagems.effect: Target model gains Protector and Vigilance until your next Strategic Phase.

stratagems.name: Overcome Pain
stratagems.effect: Target Warrior not in Incapacitated State may regain 1 HP.
